role: Monochrome sidebar navigation. Separate from colorful project/stage/app artwork.

icons.name: projects
icons.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: small monochrome navigation icon for Neotrix Prism, a premium desktop application. Generate ONE original icon isolated on a genuinely transparent background. All material is a SINGLE neutral pearl-white hue with extremely faint lavender in the shadows; absolutely no rainbow, pink, cyan, green, gold, multicolor, saturated color or colored badge. CleanMyMac-style restrained small sidebar symbol: sculpted rounded silhouette, subtle solid thickness and soft bevel, satin pearl finish, modest upper-left highlight and gentle ambient occlusion. Nearly frontal, only 8 degrees above and 10 degrees left. Designed to remain readable at 24 pixels, simple silhouette with few clear large features, not a detailed ornamental illustration. No surrounding square badge, no pedestal, no ground, no cast shadow outside silhouette, no letters or words, no checkerboard. Square transparent canvas, artwork centered and occupying 78% of canvas, safe transparent margins. Same quiet material, camera, lighting and visual weight across all four navigation icons.
Subject: a compact upright creative project prism made from three interlocking chunky rounded tiles forming one cohesive abstract hub. One neutral pearl-white material everywhere. Not a folder, no floating colored confetti or tiny satellite objects.
